catalogueTitle: "I'm actually flying from Tokyo, not London."
demoRole: Structural trip-change hero / breadth proof + FX/home-currency restatement
note: Oliver Bennett (ait-draft-38, home LHR) is a distribution-debate panellist (1 Oct 15:50, PREFERRED/CHANGEABLE). Flights are ticketed LHR->SIN->LHR (issued 8 Sep, economy per clauses.cabinRules - he is not programme-critical), hotel booked, transfers not yet arranged. On 18 Sep he says he will already be in Tokyo for work and asks to fly from HND instead, while EXPLICITLY keeping the LHR return after the summit (return intent is stated — do not demo-pause on UNKNOWN return). This is NOT a simple same-corridor flight change: the outbound topology changes and the LHR inbound sector becomes obsolete after the refund deadline (15 Sep). Prefer real Atlas HND/NRT→SIN REPLAY/RECORD evidence (USD provider quotes) over synthetic MN247 inventory. With organisation homeCurrency SGD + budget/Frankfurter FX, authority reviews the home-currency restatement while preserving providerCost. Flight changes require organiser approval (flight.change). Business-equivalent cap: the event funds no more than the original LHR round trip (SGD 1180); cheaper Tokyo-origin reissue savings accrue to the event; traveller-initiated change fee / abandoned-sector value fall to the traveller.

affectedTravellers.reason: Viable HND→SIN alternatives exist on Atlas evidence (and historically MN247-class overnight shapes). PREFERRED/CHANGEABLE → standard 6h buffer. Return destination is explicitly LHR — cost split and authority can proceed without inventing a terminus. FX path: Atlas quotes in USD vs org policy in SGD require evidenced normalization (providerCost preserved; spendExposure/costDelta in home currency).

expectedReasoningHooks: Core message: this is not 'change flight' alone - the shape of the outbound trip has changed. Obsolete LHR->SIN sector, new HND->SIN sector, hotel/transfer follow-through, arrival objective unchanged (be landside in SIN before the 1 Oct 15:50 panel).

Return intent: traveller explicitly keeps LHR after the summit. Do not escalate on UNKNOWN return destination. Planner may still record that it does not auto-rebook the return on assumption — that is structural honesty, not missing intent.

Cancellation/change reasoning after the refund deadline: event-block fares were refundable until 15 Sep (rule-ait-cancellation-terms); the request arrives 18 Sep. Traveller-initiated -> fee and any abandoned value are traveller-funded (clauses.changeCancellationTreatment).

Business-equivalent airfare: the event funds no more than the original policy-compliant LHR round trip (SGD 1180). Cheaper HND-origin reprice savings accrue to the event (clauses.businessEquivalentAirfare).

FX / home currency: provider quotes may be USD; organisation policy is SGD. Deterministic FX normalization must restate spend for authority while preserving the original provider charge for execution ceilings (ADR-052; providerCost + costDelta UI contract).

Authority: flight itinerary changes require organiser/human approval (rule-ait-flight-change-approval with flight.change). After approval, provider execution/simulation at the external boundary, then observation into a viable updated trip.
Prefer Atlas HND/NRT→SIN recordings over synthetic MN inventory when both exist.
Baggage: he travels from where he already is (Tokyo) - no misrouted-bag hazard, unlike S2.
